_source: Table 2 / Fig. 3 of Genser et al. (2023), Data in Brief 48, 109117. dist_m is measured from the stop line (upstream detectors) or from the junction exit (downstream detectors). 'loops' lists every physical loop the detector id covers (Table 2: D4-D8 detect MPT+bike (+PT) on all lanes of the approach/exit); 'w' = share of the field events injected on that loop, 'route'/'vtype' = what is injected. Entries marked INFERRED are not stated in the paper.

d4._inferred: w split: d10 (N->W lane) ~857/day vs d4 ~1066/day => ~20% bikes on sg3 (N->S)

d5._inferred: w split: d9 (E->W lane) ~2137/day of d5 ~3016/day => 71% E->W (sg4), 29% E->N (sg5)

d7._inferred: events pair 285/288 with trams (d7->d6 26 s), so injected as PT S->N; d6/d7 also see MPT/bikes per Table 2 but those are rare

d8._note: Table 2 lists MPT/PT/bike, but the field data show d8 firing for 287/287 trams only (d3->d8 34 s), so only the tram loop is modelled.

d9._inferred: inner/left W_out lane (south side, E->W through): count ~2137/day ~ E->W flow

d10._inferred: outer/right W_out lane (north side, N->W right turn): count ~857/day ~ d4 car share
